notes: Events are printed AAD episode counts, not necessarily numbers of participants with AAD. Table 4 (ITT) reports S boulardii: 21 participants with 1 episode (8.5%) and 0 with 2 episodes; placebo: 15 with 1 episode (6.5%) and 2 with 2 episodes (0.9%). No combined placebo participant count or percentage is calculated here. The active percentage refers to participants with 1 episode; no percentage is printed for the 19 placebo episodes. Denominators are randomized ITT totals. The primary-endpoint text separately states 40 cases in 425 study participants without arm-specific denominators. The main outcome uses the modified WHO definition (at least 2 days), with onset not before the third day of antibiotic treatment. Alternative PP results in Table 4: n = 146 per arm; S boulardii 16 with 1 episode (11.0%), 0 with 2; placebo 11 with 1 episode (7.5%), 2 with 2 (1.4%). WHO-definition sensitivity analyses are referenced but their supplementary results are NOT_IN_PACKET.
